fact: Tunisie.fr says The Dot's Dot Landing programme has supported 35 startups across two cohorts (27 with Region Ile-de-France, FIPA and MEET Africa 2; 8 with GIZ Tunisia) and opened applications for further cohorts.
Smart Tunisian Technoparks (S2T) is described as the first technopark in Tunisia dedicated to ICT; no programme or tenants are stated.
NVIDIA says Novation City, a technology park in Sousse, runs several startup accelerator programs, with more than 10 participating companies in NVIDIA Inception.
The Dot, a digital innovation hub in Tunisia, says it has supported over 500 startups since 2021 and incubated 140 startups from ten governorates.
